health_icr.label: Health incurred claims ratio
health_icr.formula: Net claims incurred ÷ net earned premium (health, excl. PA & travel), as published by IRDAI
health_icr.note: Above 100% means health claims cost more than the premium earned that year. It does not measure customer service or approval chances.

market_share.label: Share of India's health premium
market_share.formula: Insurer's gross health premium ÷ all insurers' gross health premium (excl. PA & travel)

solvency.label: Solvency ratio
solvency.formula: Available solvency margin ÷ required solvency margin, quarterly, as published. IRDAI minimum: 1.50

complaints_raw.label: New complaints
complaints_raw.formula: 2018-19 to 2023-24: 'actual complaints' (duplicates removed). 2014-15 to 2017-18: 'reported'. 2024-25: reported minus opening balance (IRDAI footnote: reported includes opening)

complaints_per_10k.label: All-product complaints per 10,000 health policies — rough indicator
complaints_per_10k.formula: New reported complaints ÷ health policies × 10,000. The complaint numerator includes all reported products while the denominator is health policies; this is not an exact health-complaint rate.

repudiated_pct.label: Claims repudiated (% of claims decided)
repudiated_pct.formula: Claims repudiated ÷ (paid + repudiated + closed) × 100. Health only for stand-alone health insurers; all products (motor, fire, health…) for multi-line insurers.
repudiated_pct.note: These are outcomes recorded in the reporting year, not the rejection probability for claims newly registered in that year.

pending_pct.label: Year-end outstanding share of claims workload
pending_pct.formula: Claims outstanding at year-end ÷ (claims outstanding at start + claims intimated during year) × 100.
pending_pct.note: This is a year-end outstanding snapshot relative to the workload available during the year, not the share of newly filed claims still pending.

network.label: Network providers listed by IRDAI
network.formula: Count of providers listed under direct agreements and TPA arrangements in the relevant state or across the table, 2024–25. The same provider may appear for several insurers.
network.note: This is a 2024–25 snapshot, not a ten-year series, and does not guarantee cashless availability at a specific hospital.
